recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, low-angle group portrait featuring three figures in urban attire, characterized by a warm, sepia-drenched color palette, heavy film grain, and distressed, layered typography that integrates with the foreground subject.
coreVisualRelationships: Low-angle perspective creating a sense of dominance and scale
Textured, industrial background contrasting with smooth skin tones
Typography overlapping the central figure to create depth
Warm amber lighting contrasting with deep black shadows
coreInvariants: Warm sepia or amber color grading

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Three figures arranged in a triangular formation; the central figure is most prominent in the mid-ground, flanked by two figures in the foreground and background.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The central figure's face and the large, distressed title text overlapping their chest.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large foreground figure on the left, moves down to the central text, then up to the central figure, and finally to the figure on the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is tightly packed with figures and industrial background elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep amber and sepia tones providing the overall mood.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Black shadows and dark leather textures for depth.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright white distressed highlights in the typography.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast with desaturated, monochromatic color leaning heavily into warm yellows and oranges.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to warm earth tones and high-contrast monochrome

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Heavy, condensed slab serif and sans-serif
letterConstructionRules: Rough, eroded edges and internal distressing
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature 'grunge' textures where parts of the stroke appear missing or faded
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A heavily distressed, large slab serif paired with a clean, ultra-condensed sans-serif for legibility.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary vertical weight and condensed structure.
Matches the rugged, industrial feel of the primary display text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle, wide-angle photo of three men in leather jackets and sunglasses standing in an industrial hallway. Apply a heavy sepia and amber color grade with high contrast and film grain. The background should have blurred industrial textures.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large, distressed, white slab-serif text in the lower center, overlapping the middle figure. Below it, add a single line of ultra-condensed orange sans-serif text across the bottom.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette predominantly amber/sepia?
Does the text have a weathered, eroded texture?
Is the lighting high-contrast with deep shadows?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the individuals
Exact wording of the original title

mustAchieve: Strong sense of depth through overlapping elements
avoid: High-saturation colors outside the amber spectrum

postGenerationChecks: Ensure text weathering looks organic, not procedural
Verify that shadows are deep black without losing all detail
Confirm the triangular composition of the subjects
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Gritty Portrait = (Low-Angle Wide Shot + High Contrast Lighting) * (Sepia Grade + Film Grain) + (Distressed Condensed Typography Overlap)
